Cancer genes and survival
Plain language Technical

For Jacob · the 33 deck questions, replicated and extended

Survival by alteration across the GENIE and cBioPortal datasets

Each question is answered three ways: the deck's cBioPortal figure reproduced under its own definition, the corrected analysis next to it, and a one-line verdict. Charts are interactive; every number traces to a CSV in the repository and to the executed notebook for its dataset.

Conventions used in every notebook

Index date
Diagnosis of the index cancer (BPC tt_os_dx), as in the deck. Treatment questions: OS from regimen start (tt_os_g), metastatic-setting regimens only. AKT1: from metastatic diagnosis. GENIE v20: from the sequencing report (the only index available).
Alterations
mut = any non-synonymous somatic mutation (no OncoKB filter, the files lack it); amp = discrete +2; homdel = −2; fus = any structural variant on the gene. Questions that say "mutation" use mut; CDKN2A/B, MTAP, ERG and ALK questions use the type the deck names.
One sample per patient
Earliest sequenced sample of the index cancer (BPC) or the primary (portal). A patient is wild-type for a gene only if the gene is on that sample's panel; otherwise excluded from that comparison.
Profiles
Mutually exclusive groups for multi-gene questions; the overlap cBioPortal's group comparison drops (e.g. KEAP1+STK11, PIK3CA+TP53) is kept as its own group.
Statistics
Kaplan–Meier with log-rank p (what cBioPortal shows) plus a Cox HR left-truncated at the sequencing report (HR (LT)); adjusted models add stage and age, subtype in breast, IDH in glioma, centre in v20. Screens: ≥10 per group, Benjamini–Hochberg FDR, q<0.1 flagged.
cBioPortal replication
Its "OS from start of treatment" attributes are per regimen; its group comparison excludes patients in both groups. Replicates use those exact definitions first.

All verdicts

By dataset

Open decisions

  • N5 response definition. BPC PFS-I/M medians on osimertinib are ~5 months; time to next treatment (≥12 vs <6 months) was used. If you prefer PFS-I, the screen is in N5_pfs_i_screen_on_osimertinib.csv.
  • Alteration scope. All non-synonymous variants counted. An OncoKB oncogenic filter would need the OncoKB API; it would mostly shrink the TP53 and KMT2D groups.
  • Treatment-effect questions (N4, A2, B2, Br2, Br4). Regimen-start OS with line-of-therapy tables is as far as these data go without a target-trial design; the pieces (regimen dates, lines, metastatic flags) are in the loader.
  • ERG in prostate. Any ERG-degrader framing should restrict to panels that call the rearrangement (MSK-IMPACT468, DFCI-ONCOPANEL-3, VICC-01-T7).
  • GENIE v20 small-n hits (EGFR, NF2, ROS1 mutations in ALK-fusion NSCLC, n≈13 each) are leads, not results.
  • DFCI metastatic breast cancer earned its place as an independent replication cohort (M1, M2); it could also serve C2-type pre/post questions (M3).

Data: AACR Project GENIE (BPC cohorts and the v20.0-public release, via Synapse) and genie.cbioportal.org (AKT1, DFCI glioma and DFCI metastatic breast studies). Analysis code, notebooks and tables: explore-genie. Built by Daniel Feller with Claude Code, October 2026.

These are statistical associations in past patients from a handful of academic hospitals. They are not predictions for any individual and not treatment advice.
